one_liner_zh: 艾司摩爾EPS超預期、營收年增13.25%，EUV微影龍頭地位穩固。
one_liner_en: ASML beats EPS with 13.25% revenue growth, cementing its EUV lithography lead.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+7.99%，營收年增13.25%，先進製程設備需求穩健。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：EPS超預期、營收年增13.25%，AI帶動的先進製程資本支出回升使設備龍頭受惠。短中期股價由EUV與High-NA訂單能見度驅動，技術獨佔提供護城河。追蹤指標：新增訂單（bookings）、EUV與High-NA出貨、各區域營收占比與出口管制影響、服務業務成長。訂單批次性使單季波動大，須以淨訂單趨勢而非單季營收評估動能；63倍本益比仰賴成長持續兌現。
ai_view_en: Signal positive: EPS beat and 13.25% revenue growth, with AI-driven advanced-node capex benefiting the equipment leader. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by EUV and High-NA order visibility, with a technology monopoly as the moat. Track: bookings, EUV and High-NA shipments, regional revenue mix and export-control impact, and service growth. Lumpy orders make quarters volatile, so assess momentum via net bookings rather than single-quarter revenue; a 63x P/E depends on continued growth delivery.
highlights_zh: EPS 7.15美元，超出預期6.62美元，驚喜幅度7.99%。
營收87.7億美元，年增13.25%，反映先進製程投資回升。
EUV與High-NA EUV微影設備獨家地位，技術護城河深厚。
AI驅動的先進邏輯與記憶體擴產帶動設備需求。
服務與升級業務提供穩定經常性收入。
highlights_en: EPS of $7.15 beat the $6.62 estimate by 7.99%.
Revenue of $8.77B grew 13.25% YoY on recovering advanced-node investment.
Exclusive EUV and High-NA EUV position provides a deep technology moat.
AI-driven advanced logic and memory expansion drives equipment demand.
Service and upgrade business provides stable recurring revenue.
risks_zh: 訂單具批次性，季度營收與預訂波動較大。
地緣政治與出口管制限制特定市場銷售。
本益比63.97倍，估值反映高度成長預期。
risks_en: Lumpy order patterns make quarterly revenue and bookings volatile.
Geopolitics and export controls restrict sales to certain markets.
A P/E of 63.97 reflects high growth expectations.
